    feat: load AGENTS.md into the system prompt (#61)
    
    A built-in pi-durable extension, pi-action-context, installed after the
    coding tools and before the extensions, adds a project_context section like
    pi's Project Context block: <agent_dir>/AGENTS.md (when agent_dir is set),
    then AGENTS.md or else CLAUDE.md for each directory from the workspace root
    down to cwd, never above GITHUB_WORKSPACE. Nested files are listed, not
    loaded. The files are read once for each run, so edits during a run don't
    update the section (or break the prompt cache).
    
    New inputs: context_files (default true) and context_files_max_bytes
    (default 65536). On pull requests from forks, the files come from the base
    commit of the pull request.
    
    Refs #53

81: <<<<<<< HEAD
82: ## Context files from the repository
83: 
84: `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` go into the system prompt (see [Context files](prompts.md#context-files)). The system prompt has more weight for the model than a file that it reads. pi-action reads these files from the checkout, so their content is the content of the checked-out ref:
85: 
86: - **Pull requests from forks** (`pull_request` events whose head is in another repository): pi-action reads the files from the base commit of the pull request (`pull_request.base.sha`), and fetches it if the clone does not have it. If it cannot read the base commit, it loads no workspace files and writes a warning. The author of the fork cannot change the system prompt.
87: - **Pull requests from branches of the same repository:** pi-action uses the `AGENTS.md` of the branch. People who can push a branch can already change the code that your workflow runs.
88: - pi-action removes invisible characters from the files, but keeps HTML comments, because `AGENTS.md` files use them.
89: - Set `context_files: false` to load no files.
90: =======
91: ## Skills from the repository
92: 
93: A [skill](skills.md) is instructions that pi follows, and it can tell pi to run its scripts. Anyone who can push a branch can change the files in `.pi/skills` and `.agents/skills`. Thus, pi-action loads them only with `trust_project: true`. Without it, pi-action writes `Not loading the skills in .pi/skills: trust_project is off` to the log (with the directories that exist). Skills from `extensions`, `skills`, and `agent_dir` load in all cases. Pin the packages, as for [extensions](#extensions).
